caption: The call button beside an elevator is pressed, and the button lights up.

sa.check: A call button beside an elevator.
The button is dark before the press.
The order is dark, press, lit.

pc.expect: The button lights at the moment it is pressed, and only then.
pc.fail: The button is pressed and stays dark; or the button is lit before it is pressed; or the button lights with nothing touching it; or a different button lights instead.

pc.expect: Once lit, the button stays lit for the rest of the clip, or goes out only when the elevator doors open.
pc.fail: The button goes dark again with the doors still closed; or flickers on and off; or brightens and dims repeatedly; or lights and goes out with each frame.

pc.expect: The button and its plate stay in the wall as they are pressed; the doors stay closed until they open in one motion.
pc.fail: The plate moves along the wall; or the button sinks deep into the wall and stays sunk; or the doors jerk open and shut repeatedly; or the floor indicator numbers spin.

pc.expect: The button's glow lights the plate around it faintly; the glow is at the button and nowhere else.
pc.fail: The glow appears on the wall away from the button while the button stays dark; or the whole plate lights up as brightly as the button; or the glow floats in front of the wall.

pc.expect: One button plate with its buttons in fixed places; the doors and wall keep their shape; the finger passes through nothing.
pc.fail: Buttons appear or vanish; or a second plate appears; or the finger passes into the wall; or the elevator doors change shape or vanish.

pc.expect: The plate's finish, the doors' colour and the wall stay the same apart from the glow.
pc.fail: The plate changes colour; or the doors change colour; or the floor numbers change style.
